0x00010000.name: INT_CONNECT_REQ
0x00010000.description: Internal event (never on the wire): connect request to ip:port.

0x00010001.name: INT_DISCONNECT
0x00010001.description: Internal event (never on the wire): disconnect.

0x00010002.name: INT_CONNECTED
0x00010002.description: Internal event (never on the wire): session established.

0x00010003.name: INT_CLOSED
0x00010003.description: Internal event (never on the wire): session closed.

0x00010004.name: INT_CONNECT_FAILED
0x00010004.description: Internal event (never on the wire): connect failed or 7000 ms timeout.

0x00010005.name: INT_LATENCY
0x00010005.description: Internal event (never on the wire): latency statistics (4 x u32).

0x00020080.name: CON
0x00020080.description: Client hello, first packet after TCP connect; cipher key still 0x0F.

0x00020081.name: CON_ACK
0x00020081.description: Server hello. Sets the cipher key (key0^key1) and session blob.

layout.meaning: copied to session+0x35; purpose unknown (zeros seen)

0x00020082.name: CON_CONFIRM
0x00020082.description: Client confirms handshake; session becomes Established.

0x00020083.name: PING
0x00020083.description: Keepalive; either side sends after idle (client: >20000 ms).

0x00020084.name: PONG
0x00020084.description: Reply to PING, echoes the tick.

0x00020005.name: SESSION_ACK
0x00020005.description: Reliable-layer ACK for a sequenced packet.

0x0002008a.name: GG_AUTH_QUERY
0x0002008a.description: GameGuard CS-auth query (server -> client). The no-GG client path answers nothing.

0x03000004.name: LOGIN_V4
0x03000004.description: Login request, type 1 (long password). 100 bytes. Used by the test client.

0x03000001.name: LOGIN_ACK
0x03000001.description: Login result. 0 = OK; otherwise error code (600 = login fail UI).

layout.meaning: serial/session key (reused in PCLIST and LOCK)
flag (1 = clear an option bit; region dependent)

0x03010000.name: CHECKOUT
0x03010000.description: Pick character and leave the login server for the channel.

0x03010001.name: CHECKOUT_ACK
0x03010001.description: Checkout result; on success the client connects to the channel server.

0x03010002.name: CHECKIN
0x03010002.description: Session transfer to the game server.

0x02060003.name: PCLIST_END
0x02060003.description: End of list; client builds up to 6 slots and the Create button.

0x02040000.name: PC_OBJECT
0x02040000.description: Open one PC record; creates the PC object and parses it (115 bytes on wire).

layout.meaning: PC info record parsed via vtbl+0x1c; field map not recovered

0x02040001.name: PC_SUIT
0x02040001.description: Per-PC equipment appearance ("suit") blob; bytes from +0x18 to end.

0x04000000.name: LOCK
0x04000000.description: Lock the account onto this game server.

layout.meaning: player object id (matches later 050d0000 actor id)

0x050d0007.name: ENTER_WORLD
0x050d0007.description: Server tells the client which map to load. Handler FUN_0050a520 immediately sends ENTER_DONE 0x09020000.

layout.meaning: map index (7 = 07_loa_castle in the session captured)

0x09020000.name: ENTER_DONE
0x09020000.description: Client finished loading the map (empty body). Server then starts sending world objects.

0x05040000.name: MONSTER_APPEAR
0x05040000.description: A monster enters view. Handler FUN_005394f0 ("New Enter : Monster(%08X)"). Creates a Monster actor from the client monster table using the index at +0x14.

layout.meaning: monster index (share/creature/monster.csv Index; 701 Blaverus, 3510 Akris seen)
current HP (equals server monster.csv MaxHP: 258 for 701, 1079 for 3510)
position/movement block passed whole to the actor (bytes seen 36 26 00 00 00 ca 80 73 c8 2c 00 01 ...)
effect/buff ids; each non-zero entry is applied

0x05050000.name: NPC_APPEAR
0x05050000.description: An NPC enters view. Handler FUN_00538a70 ("New Enter : NPC(%08X)").

layout.meaning: NPC index (share/creature/npc.csv; 727 = Emily, 721 = Audrey, 732 = Pluto seen)
position/direction (handler copies +0x16 hi word and +0x1a); exact split unknown
passed with the object id to the NPC icon/state setter

0x05050002.name: NPC_DIALOG_OPEN_ACK
0x05050002.description: Opens the NPC dialog (pCreature/pDialog checks in FUN_0076ce70).

0x05050003.name: NPC_DIALOG_SELECT
0x05050003.description: Choose a dialog entry/job of the NPC.

0x05050005.name: NPC_ICON_REQ
0x05050005.description: Ask for the NPC overhead icon/state, sent for every NPC that appears.

0x050d0000.name: ACTOR_ACTION
0x050d0000.description: Movement/action of an actor. Client sends it for its own character and for monsters it controls; the server echoes it back. Handler FUN_0053a340 switches on +0x1f.

layout.meaning: actor object id (player or controlled monster)
action kind (handler switch; 0x02 = move seen most; 0x11 reads +0x20)
action data; for some kinds a string from +0x30 when len >= 0x31

0x050d0001.name: SECTOR_REPORT
0x050d0001.description: Client reports its current sector/cell index when it changes (builder FUN_00524500).

0x050d0002.name: ACTOR_SECTOR_CHANGE
0x050d0002.description: A controlled actor moved between sectors ("%u sector -> %u sector").

0x050d0004.name: MONSTER_CONTROL
0x050d0004.description: Server hands control (AI/movement) of a monster to this client ("%X Controlled by %X"; unknown id -> "Unhandled Monster Control Packet").

0x050d0005.name: OBJECTS_DISAPPEAR
0x050d0005.description: Remove objects from view. List of object ids (length 20 = 1 id, 24 = 2 ids). INFERRED from ids matching earlier APPEAR packets.

0x05260000.name: ENTER_WORLD_BLOCK_0526
0x05260000.description: Large block sent right after ENTER_WORLD (280 bytes). Content not decoded.

0x050a0000.name: NPC_SHOP_OPEN
0x050a0000.description: Shop/job window open reply after NPC_DIALOG_SELECT. INFERRED.

0x050a0002.name: NPC_SHOP_DATA
0x050a0002.description: Shop/job data (60 bytes). Content not decoded.
